body:
## Refresh on main `3fc0e017b`

I merged `main` `3fc0e017b` into the branch. The head is now `34ab20e80`. Every conflict is resolved and both review findings are fixed.

### Findings and fixes

1. **Four union conflicts.** Both sides add one operation to the same list. I kept both sides. The files:
   - `crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs:54`, `:71`
   - `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:51`
   - `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md:34`
   - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch.rs:181`

   The support text is now "Trace, 2D Offset, 2D Adaptive, 3D Pocket, Face and 3D Finish". `do_not_touch_applies` accepts `OpType::Adaptive2D` and `OpType::Finish3D`. The UI test checks a substring of the new text.

2. **The Gate-map name.** `crates/app/tests/do_not_touch_adaptive.rs:3` now names `motion::machining2d::adaptive_avoid`. The old line named `motion::machining2d::adaptive_troch_avoid`, which is not a module. It also named `pocket_avoid`, which the adaptive generator does not use. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs:100` declares `adaptive_avoid`.

3. **A new conflict in `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`.** Main moved after the review. Main adds rest machining on 2D Adaptive (#1446). This PR restructures the same adaptive closure for "Do not touch" (#3346). No planner handles both.

   The choice is option A:
   - Main's `(Some(r), _)` rest branch stays first. The avoid arms run under `None` rest.
   - The rest planner takes no keep-out. `verify_avoid` then checks the rest path. A hit is `Warning::AvoidHit`, and `blocks_post()` is true. So the post is blocked. This is a feature gap, not a wrong answer.
   - I dropped the avoid-first order. It silently turns rest machining off. I also dropped keep-out planning for a rest pass, because no planner takes both inputs.

   Follow-up issue #3702 designs a planner or a named refusal for the combination (`P8`, `effort:high`, `area:2d`).

### Readings on `34ab20e80` (`CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=3`, `-j 3`)

- `cargo check -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app`: pass, 2m 38s.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test avoid_adaptive`: 6 passed, 0 failed, 48.36s.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test do_not_touch_adaptive`: 2 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored (heavy lane), 14.65s.
- `cargo clippy --no-deps -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean, 3m 03s.

I did not run the heavy lanes. This is a `P3` PR (#3558).

### State

- The `conflicts` label is removed. The branch merges with `main`.
- `needs-rework` stays. I do not set `merge-ready`.
- The PR stays a draft. The maintainer merges it by hand, because the author is not a collaborator.
- Every finding is closed. Please re-review `34ab20e80`.

Second safety read (read-only, not built) at head `34ab20e80`: no blocker.

- The keep-out comes from the shared code of #2055. It covers the flutes, the shank and the holder, and it can only grow. An independent swept check (`verify_avoid`) judges the final path and blocks the post on a hit.

Notes, not blockers:

- The check `confined` of the Trochoidal method reads only the end points of a straight feed. The post block catches a miss.
- The tests assert "no hit". None asserts a measured minimum distance.
- The test of the case with no room does not read the blocked post.
- Rest machining with "Do not touch" has no keep-out in the planner and no refusal by name; the post block catches a hit. #3702 has this.

Route note. The merge route is the coordinator's. Another session merged this PR (merge commit `2de071415`) before the trial merge ran here. A tip check of `2de071415` with the Adaptive and "Do not touch" test binaries and the light lane runs when a build slot is free. Its result comes here. Thank you for the work.

Record: this PR is mergeable at head `34ab20e80` as of main `81643a2`; the review is clean and `merge-ready` (option A, the unions, the Gate-map fix, no safety loss). The refresh-at-merge flow applies: at merge time, merge main into the branch, run the touched suites, then merge. The maintainer merges this one by hand (the author is not a collaborator). No refresh now.
